mike_csm: Heads up: HelioHealth onboarding call tomorrow 11am PT. Need clear SLOs to confirm for renewal and any potential credits. Can we sync? 🧭
laura_cs: Onboarding health: 2/3 migration steps done, latency tests showing ~220ms p95. They expect 150ms. Concerned about renewal if not hitting target.
sam_platform: @mike_csm @laura_cs we have two knobs: route to dedicated pool or enable aggressive batching. Dedicated hits 130-160ms p95 in staging.
raj_sre: Batching reduces cost but raises tail under spikes. For uptime targets we're at 99.98% last 30d; had a 6m outage last month due to autoscaler bug.
mike_csm: Customer asked about credits % if we miss monthly latency SLO. What formula do we promise?
laura_cs: We have standard SLA doc but it's vague on latency credits. Typically: if p95 > target for >3 days in month => prorated credit. Need exact thresholds for HelioHealth.
sam_platform: Propose: Target p95 <= 160ms. If monthly p95 between 160-220ms => 5% credit. >220ms => 15% credit. Uptime <99.9% => 10% credit for partial month, <99.5% => 25% credit. Open to edits.
raj_sre: Add guard: credits only if issue is infra-qualified and not customer-caused. Also allow one exception for onboarding migration disruptions.
laura_cs: Can you draft a short customer-facing one-pager with those thresholds? I'll take to the call. Simple table + what triggers credit + expected remediation SLAs.
sam_platform: I'll draft and post here in 30m. Quick ask: what's the telemetry id for HelioHealth so we can pull last 90d p95? (helpful to know gap)
mike_csm: Telemetry id: helio-prod-07. Also forward any logs to me. Call invite already sent.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled rollout redwood-dedicated-pool-2 -> prod at 02:00 UTC. No expected impact but FYI.
raj_sre: Noted. If we roll during onboarding window, could impact latency. Let's avoid 10-12am PT tomorrow.
laura_cs: Thanks — I'll move the call to 1pm PT if that helps.
mike_csm: :thumbsup: moving to 1pm PT now. Sam, ping when draft ready.
